prior_Amdahl_5_0507_status: Superseded by actual executed model; not an achieved result or reliable prediction.

bottleneck.overlap_rule: tail + max(local_S_read_finish, compute_body_finish, adapter_finish, shared_feed_finish); consumer stages sum only within the same P
bottleneck.conclusion: At best idealdual, aggregate P service equals unchanged M work including tails. Further shared-feed reduction is hidden under the compute/adapter floor. Shared local port layer still has local-S serialization and ACK overlap costs.
bottleneck.not_claimed: ACK wait is not pure external bandwidth latency; aggregate memory, credit, port and latency waits are overlapping work and must not be added to wall time.
